title: Share of tested samples/people with microplastics found (percent)

source.name: Plasticenta / human blood microplastics / carotid atheroma studies
source.publisher: University of New Mexico (placenta, 2024); Environment International (Leslie et al., blood, 2022); New England Journal of Medicine (Marfella et al., artery plaque, 2024)

notes: Three separate peer-reviewed studies, different sample groups: microplastics were found in 100% of 62 human placenta samples (Univ. of New Mexico, 2024); in 77% of 22 healthy blood donors (Leslie et al., Environment International, 2022); and in 58.4% of 257 patients' carotid artery plaque (Marfella et al., NEJM, 2024).
